description: ONE FRONT male haircut inspired by Death the Kid from Soul Eater, adapted to this EXACT original Project Shaman head. Compact smooth center-part hairstyle, rounded low crown, two broad straight curtain fringe locks forming a clean M opening over forehead, tapered straight sides ending beside ears. Sleek precise locks, NOT tousled, spiky or swept to one side. Both eyes fully visible. Render the MAIN HAIR in pale SILVER with light-grey shadows so runtime palette can make it black. CRITICAL: THREE SEPARATE thin parallel HORIZONTAL bands across ONLY character LEFT side (viewer RIGHT), on upper right half of the hair: one near crown, one below it, one above temple. Paint those three bands saturated PURE RED as semantic markers; editor will turn them WHITE. Red markers follow hair curvature, separated by hair rows; no red anywhere else. These are flat hair markings, NOT ribbons or accessories. No stripe on viewer left. Native crisp chunky pixel clusters, few highlights, top-left light. Max4px above/3px beside head. Preserve face eyes brows ears jaw neck exactly outside white mask. Transparent head only, no torso, clothing, extra view or full character.
